news.headline:
Mangalam Global Enterprise Ltd's 16th AGM is set for July 27, 2026, via VC/OAVM format.

Agenda includes audited financials, dividend declaration, director reappointment, and approval of borrowing limits.

Source: BSE

Fujiyama Power Systems schedules analyst/investor meeting on July 9 at 4pm.

Source: Livesquawk
